# Agentic Synth Twin

> Local macOS research prototype for learning and validating a reproducible digital twin of a CLAP synthesizer.

## Canonical documentation

- [Project overview](README.md): hypothesis, human calibration, LOCK principle, roadmap, and scope
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): conceptual chain, boundaries, invariants, and decisions
- [CLAP feasibility](docs/clap-feasibility.md): pinned build, probe evidence, and known upstream limitations
- [Canonical synth state](docs/canonical-synth-state.md): versioned state contract, validation, authority boundaries, and reproduction
- [Deterministic audition](docs/deterministic-audition.md): fixed C3 render contract, WAV evidence, browser playback, and limitations
- [Human A/B probe](docs/human-ab-probe.md): local blinded calibration, SQLite persistence, first pilot judgment, and limitations
- [DSP features](docs/dsp-features.md): deterministic formulas, regenerated A/B measurements, local report, and limitations
- [Synthetic dataset](docs/synthetic-dataset.md): three-parameter sampling, local WAV policy, committed evidence, explorer, and limitations
- [Direct real-synth search](docs/direct-real-synth-search.md): four-parameter CMA-ES, audio objective, live cockpit, random control, and actual result
- [Playable cockpit](docs/playable-cockpit.md): editable working patch, virtual/computer/USB MIDI inputs, real-synth rendered-note cache, and limitations
- [Surge one-note match](docs/surge-one-note-match.md): ten external targets, shared eligible-preset retrieval, target-specific local refinement, hidden regression fixture, preserved playable instrument, and evidence
- [Perceptual multi-start refinement](docs/perceptual-multistart-refinement.md): complete-library perceptual starts, transparent hierarchical real-control screening, fixed two-stage CMA schedule, independent stable rerender, and preserved playable cockpit
- [Perceptual multi-start PR brief](docs/pr-briefs/perceptual-multistart-refinement.md): implementation boundary, change ledger, verification evidence, and owner acceptance still required
- [Perceptual multi-start evidence](docs/evidence/perceptual-multistart-refinement.json): full path-sanitized Rhodes, electric-guitar, and sub-bass screen, CMA, and verification records
- [Agent contract](AGENTS.md): repository rules, current milestone boundary, and checks
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): focused PR workflow
- [Security](SECURITY.md): private vulnerability reporting guidance

## Current status

The current follow-up preserves Milestone 9 while testing whether five complete-library perceptual starts and a metadata-plus-measurement hierarchical screen can produce better stable real-Surge one-note matches. Target selection still never starts optimization; the same virtual/computer/USB MIDI keyboard and editable working-copy contract remain authoritative. The hidden reachable-target experiment remains a separate regression fixture; other notes are exploratory, objective similarity is not human perception, owner listening remains required, and LOCK remains incomplete.
